# Incline - Rise.Reflect.Repeat.
> Rajasthan's premier luxury fitness facility located in Udaipur, featuring Olympic-grade equipment, advanced recovery tech, and a 100% digital onboarding experience.

## Specifications & Amenities
- Atmosphere: 100% AC, active aroma diffusers, strictly no ceiling fans, QSC Brand Audio, and premium Digital Lockers.
- Recovery: Separate Male and Female Recovery Rooms featuring 15 KVA Steam Generators, precision commercial Cold Plunge, full-spectrum sauna with carbon heaters, and 7-wavelength Red Light Therapy.
- Floor: 70+ weight/powerlifting machines, massive Olympic-grade cardio area, and a dedicated Pilates and Yoga Room.
